sources.title: Engram | Architecting Cognition
sources.snippet: Engram is an applied AI research lab focused on architecting cognition. We build systems that augment human intelligence by combining memory, reasoning, and continuous learning.

sources.title: Engram — Persistent Memory for AI Agents
sources.snippet: The open-source context database that gives AI agents structured, persistent memory across sessions, models, and platforms.

sources.title: Engram AI — memory core for engineering teams
sources.snippet: engram is a thin, opinionated stack assembled from boring components and one practical idea — an engineering memory layer should cite the code and docs it used instead of guessing from model memory.
